data.heading: Why this order is worth it
paras: The Artificial Advantage ebook. Fifteen chapters of method, built around CLEAR: choose your tools, lead with clear direction, evolve your outputs, audit for accuracy, and repeat. You learn to brief AI so the first answer is close to what you meant, then check it before your name goes on it.
The 7-Day AI Workbook. One stage of that system each day, for seven days, on one real task of your own. You finish with a before and an after, and a template you keep.
The Toolkit. The exercises, the 30-day and 3-month practice plans, the Prompt Library, the Role Library and the Tool-Selection Cheat Sheet, as files you can open and edit.

The Companion Library. Eight reference pages I keep current, and the Director's Cheat Sheet. The third picture is that cheat sheet. Both are free on the site. They are in this order so you are not hunting for them later.
